comment: Catalyzes ether bond formation and C-8 hydroxylation of 4-O-demethylbarbatic acid to produce convirensic acid.

reactions.description: Oxidative cyclization (ether bond formation) and C-8 hydroxylation of a depside to a depsidone.
Conversion of 4-O-demethylbarbatic acid (depside) to convirensic acid (depsidone).
